designOrigin: Trial 26 produced no economic output. Its source-only acquisition exposed documented Hyperliquid settlement-publication delays and an exchange-wide missing funding hour. Trial 27 changes only the source/economic clock: funding is booked when it was actually published/settled, avoiding scheduled-hour lookahead. No Trial 27 economic output was observed before freeze.
hypothesis: A literature-direction cross-venue carry protected by a causal trailing funding-spread sign regime can preserve the static Binance-long/Hyperliquid-short carry in normal regimes while reversing exposure in sustained negative-spread regimes, improving both return and Sharpe after conservative costs.

finalHoldout.accessRule: Final market rows and economics may be observed only after every development gate passes.

benchmark.name: static_literature_direction
benchmark.rule: From the first eligible boundary, always hold equal-coin long Binance perpetual and short Hyperliquid perpetual.

candidate.name: event_time_regime_protected_carry
candidate.rule: Before 90 completed prior 8h cash-settlement buckets exist, retain the literature direction. Thereafter compute the arithmetic mean of the prior 90 completed Hyperliquid-minus-Binance realized funding buckets, excluding the current bucket. Hold long Binance/short Hyperliquid when positive and reverse both legs when negative. Retain prior direction on exact zero. Reversal closes and reopens both legs with full modeled costs.

fundingClock.binance: Use the Binance funding settlement at each exact 8h boundary.
fundingClock.hyperliquid: Use raw fundingHistory publication/settlement timestamps with no timestamp backdating. For each 8h interval (previous boundary, current boundary], sum every Hyperliquid fundingRate record whose raw timestamp falls in that interval. A delayed settlement therefore belongs to the later cash interval in which it actually appeared. A missing settlement contributes no cash payment; no rate is interpolated or fabricated.
fundingClock.causality: At boundary t, first book funding cash that actually settled by t to the position held during the preceding interval, then make the t direction decision using completed buckets ending strictly before t.

fundingNotionalApproximation.rule: Funding cash uses frozen position coin units times the venue's current 8h close times the realized funding rate. Historical oracle/mark-at-settlement is not publicly available from the selected free endpoint, so this is an explicit approximation applied identically across candidate and benchmark.

costModel.application: Each leg pays fee plus slippage on every open and close/reversal.

marginModel.rule: Fail if either venue balance falls below maintenance or fails an instantaneous adverse 20% move before hedge offset.

literatureTarget.rule: A promoted candidate must also beat the frozen static literature-direction implementation under identical data, costs, capital, and margin assumptions.

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 27 development economic output, no scientific parameter, asset, threshold, gate, leverage, cost, clock rule, or direction rule may change under Trial 27.
